headline: US LNG Exports Near Record High on European Winter Demand
summary: U.S. liquefied natural gas shipments to Europe rose by 1 million tons last month to 6.89 million tons as European buyers build energy stocks ahead of winter.
why: Liquefied natural gas exports from the United States are critical for European energy security and global natural gas price benchmark movements.

impacts.name: US Natural Gas
impacts.why: Higher LNG export volumes to Europe tightened domestic supplies and raised prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: U.S. LNG exports rose toward historic highs as European utilities increased purchases ahead of winter heating season.
